intent: Repair the live-proven SADHANA R2 pinned-uv traversal contradiction without weakening root custody. The immutable hash-pinned uv tree must remain root-owned and non-writable by every non-root principal while its directory chain is executable by the isolated build identity. Converge both fresh installation and the exact legacy mode-0700 installation already admitted on AGNI to a stable mode-0755 root through a no-follow descriptor custody transition. Preserve exact wheel hashing, copied-binary checks, no-root candidate execution, AGNI standby fencing, and all writer/dispatch locks.

commit.message: fix(runtime): admit pinned uv build traversal

interface_mismatches: The exact sealed release 68696695b03940ba56481da59aed27c281316e5e passed non-root host verification and both repaired staging-custody gates, then its isolated AGNI child rejected the absolute uv path as unavailable before the first lifecycle command.

provision_pinned_uv creates its staging root with tempfile mode 0700 and renames that mode unchanged into /opt/dharma-sadhana/tooling/uv-0.11.2. The executable and every other ancestor are mode 0755, but the isolated build UID cannot traverse this root-owned 0700 component.

RootImmutableExecutableTree(owner=root, root/bin/uv mode0755, marker mode0644, writes=root-only) is the required type. The fix must converge only an already-validated exact legacy-private mode set (0700 directories and executable, 0600 marker) or that exact final mode set through stable no-follow descriptors, while retaining hash, ownership, link, non-writability, marker, platform, and copied-ELF validation.
honest_blockers: The failed AGNI deployment cleaned its own staging tree. A later, deliberately separate diagnostic run was preserved by the operator as one root-owned diagnostic tree after proving zero build-UID processes and retaking root custody; no SADHANA target, writer marker, dispatch marker, supervisor, listener, or Tailscale Serve route was activated.

A passing source closeout is not authority to reuse the rejected seal. The repaired exact SHA still requires a new DocOps child, release envelope, non-root host verification, inert deploy, clock proof, and bounded activation transaction.
This packet does not authorize provider dispatch, account-confirmation promotion, writer failover, campaign activation, or merge.
session_entry.rollback: Revert only the pinned-uv traversal convergence, regressions, and this work packet before resealing. On AGNI, preserve the fail-closed evidence and root-owned diagnostic tree; a later exact release may idempotently converge only the already-validated root-owned legacy-private uv tree and reuse no conflicting tooling.
